descriptionHtml:
思路 / Approach · TC-09 All Residents Attendance Toggle (Nursing Home only) · S19 「现成的 spec：手动加的住户存成 Follow-up，添加表单一开始是 Follow-up」 Existing specs: a hand-added resident is stored as Follow-up, and the add form starts at Follow-up

覆盖的 UAT 步骤 / 票 AC：

  • U7 New residents, whether added by photo or by hand, land in All Residents as Follow-up (TC-06 defaults).（UAT TC-09；UAT TC-06 (by reference)；TFA-92587 AC 5；TFA-92587 How it works 5）

测试设计方法：等价类（equivalence） — 同一条规则换一类输入（医院 / 养老院、另一种数据）再验一次，每一类都要对。

Given Add Resident form

When Add a resident with only a name; separately open the form and read Encounter Type

Then The resident is on the roster with encType follow-up and no stored template. The form starts at Follow-up

通过的标准（oracle，节选）：Playwright assertions in forms.spec.ts (snf:list encType 'follow-up') and encounter-type.spec.ts (Encounter Type value 'follow-up'). The photo half of U7 is S04 (QA Dahlia's and QA Elm's charts) and S06

在哪跑：本地 lane A（现成 Playwright 测试）；测试方法 PW · Playwright 脚本；矩阵里排的车道 现成测试（Tim 的 Playwright）（automated）

S19 是我们自己编的用例号（覆盖矩阵 cases/TC-09.matrix.json 里的编号），不是 UAT 文档里的步骤号。

环境：本地 — main e02167f，本地栈（local stack, not a deployed build）；run folder runs/2026-10-14-local，lane A。

测试方法：PW · Playwright 脚本 — 按 cases/test-methods.json 的分类，分类说在 both 跑；来源：matrix（lane A）。

UAT item: TC-09 All Residents Attendance Toggle (Nursing Home only) · Section: A1 · Home Screen & Dashboard · Scenario: TC-09/S19

Existing specs: a hand-added resident is stored as Follow-up, and the add form starts at Follow-up

Tickets: TFA-92587 All Residents Attendance Toggle (ready for qa)

Result: passed in matrix/TC-09.results.json (lane A: the existing Playwright specs below, run on the local stack; agent-matrix.sh).

Existing specs:

  • encounter-type.spec.ts [chromium] — Nursing Home: the add form starts at Follow-up and saves the status chosen, the header sets all three, and the status pre-selects the note format — expected
  • forms.spec.ts [chromium] — accepts a resident and puts them on the roster — expected

Dev run: skipped: local-only — local-only — Lane A (Tim's Playwright specs e2e/forms.spec.ts and e2e/encounter-type.spec.ts, chromium): they make fresh @roundai.test accounts and add residents through the form; dev has no admin key, one shared account and no permission to add a patient, so they run on the local stack only (Quinn 2026-10-14).. This local result replaces that dev entry (the scenario appears once).
